messages:
pagerbot: [PAGER] alert P1 — unusual auth-proxy traffic to /v1/sso/auth. Honeypot triggered, high 401/429 rate from 34.216.??.?? cluster. Possible credential scraping. Incident channel auto-created: #inc-4977770000

alice_oncall: saw it. taking lead. tagging sec + sre. any customer impact noted? :eyes:

ben_sec: pinging logs now. initial sample shows Authorization header fragments in leaked logs pointing at staging S3 path. unclear if customer tokens present.

carla_sre: confirming service health: auth-proxy 95th latency spike but upstreams healthy. No 5xx to customers yet. I'll throttle honey traffic and enable stricter WAF rules.

alice_oncall: plan: 1) throttle/honeypot isolate 2) rotate any exposed service keys 3) reach legal + custops if PII/tokens 4) communicate to affected customers if needed. assigning tasks.

carla_sre: executed quick WAF rule: `block ip 34.216.0.0/18` and toggled honeypot to capture full headers. Rolling restart of auth-proxy to purge potential sticky sessions.

ben_sec: pulled sample payloads, saved to secure artifact store. Snippet shows partial `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...` fragments only. No complete JWT found in first pass. Running a deeper S3 grep across last 48h for token-like strings.

ben_sec: command used:
```
aws s3 cp s3://staging-logs/2026-03-14/part-0000.gz - | zgrep -E "Bearer [A-Za-z0-9-_]{20,}" -n
```
found 12 hits, all partial fragments. Elevating to P0 if we find full tokens.

carla_sre: rotating service-to-s3 write keys for the pipeline now (kv rotate in progress). I've kicked off `rotate-service-keys --target=log-forwarder` and put previous keys on denylist.

alice_oncall: ben, confirm KMS/HSM involvement for any key rotation. dave, please advise on customer notif thresholds. erin, standby for possible outreach.

ben_sec: KMS rotation plan: creating new key versions, re-encrypting target secrets, and scheduling a short window for migration. Will post timeline in 10m.

dave_legal: quick note — if tokens exposed could enable account access, we need to follow incident-notify SLA. Wait for sec to confirm whether any customer identities are in leaked fragments. Prep hold message for affected customers (do not send yet).

erin_custops: got it. staging vs prod distinction important. If staging only, customer impact minimal. if any prod tokens, prepare for 1:1 outreach and include recommended rotation steps.

carla_sre: mitigation update: honeypot capture increased. I've temporarily disabled log-forwarder to external bucket until we confirm no further leakage. This will slightly delay log delivery for internal teams (non-customer facing).

ben_sec: grep complete: 3 files show JWT-like strings that decode to valid header+payload but signature truncated. I will escalate to full forensic run. Marking `investigation: deep` in tracker.

alice_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. ben take lead on sec investigation; carla maintain mitigation/config; erin & dave keep standby for customer/legal. Leaving runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4977770000/runbook

ben_sec: taking lead. immediate tasks: 1) finish full artifact decode attempts, 2) enumerate affected API keys/services, 3) finalize key rotation window. Will update every 15m or on major milestone.

carla_sre: note for ops: `auth-proxy` can fallback to token-refresh-only path if we see signature failures; enabled that fallback to reduce false denies.

ben_sec: forensic note: attacker appears to be scraping telemetry/log endpoints for tokens. Recommend short-term disable of public log ingestion endpoints and require auth for internal log copies.

dave_legal: advising to preserve all logs/chain-of-custody. Do not delete any artifacts. Legal has been looped in and will join in 5.

erin_custops: prepping customer comms templates for both staging-only and prod-impact scenarios. ETA 30m for drafts.

alice_oncall: final quick status before handoff: mitigations in place, key rotation started, deeper forensics in progress, no confirmed customer account compromise yet. Keep channel updated. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: ACTION_LOG: incident created, severity=P1, owner=ben_sec, mitigations applied: WAF, honeypot=high-capture, key-rotation=initiated.

ben_sec: update (30m): found one completed JWT in a deprecated backup file. It decodes to non-customer test account but could be used to pivot. Rotating all related keys and invalidating sessions for that service. Raising to P0 for speed.

carla_sre: completed rotation for log-forwarder service keys. Confirmed denylist active. Re-enabled forwarder to a quarantined bucket for manual review only.

dave_legal: verified no PII visible in token payload. Legal OK with staged customer notice if any affected. Recommend broad customer scan for suspicious activity tied to related service tokens.

erin_custops: customer draft ready for prod-impact yes/no branches. Holding until ben confirms scope.

ben_sec: scope: exposure limited to staging + one deprecated backup with test creds. No active customer tokens found. Downgrading to P1 but keep monitoring for 72h. Will close once post-rotation audit confirms clean.

alice_oncall: thanks team. ben will own postmortem. carla please run a short blameless RCA and checklist to harden log pipelines. erin/dave will standby for any change. I'll close ops shift and leave on-call notes in the rota.

carla_sre: noted. will file RCA and checklist link in thread.

ben_sec: postmortem owner assigned. next update in 6h or earlier if anything new.

pagerbot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: severity -> P1 (was P0). monitoring set to 72h. Incident channel will archive after closure.

alice_oncall: offcall. good work everyone.
